new_pair.en: On the Arabian Gulf coast east of Al-Ahsa, within the complex of the historic Al-Uqair port — the first seaport on Saudi Arabia’s eastern coast — stands the port's historic mosque, where sailors, merchants and travellers once prayed at Najd's old gateway to the sea. It is counted among the port facilities built and developed in the reign of King Abdulaziz, alongside the fort, the khan, the emirate building and the customs house, in the days when Al-Uqair was Al-Ahsa's commercial artery. The mosque was restored under the historic mosques restoration programme, with the support of the Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu, among a group of Al-Ahsa's historic mosques. Today it stands within the historic port site, part of the full story the old port tells its visitors.
new_pair.zh: 乌盖尔港清真寺位于哈萨以东的海湾沿岸，就在历史悠久的乌盖尔港（Al-Uqair）建筑群之中。乌盖尔港是沙特阿拉伯东部沿海的第一座海港，昔日也是纳季德（沙特中部地区）通往大海的门户；当年往来于此的水手、商人与旅客，都曾在寺中礼拜。与要塞、商队客栈、埃米尔府和海关楼一样，这座清真寺也是阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王在位期间兴建并发展起来的港口建筑之一——那时的乌盖尔港，正是哈萨对外贸易的命脉。该寺与哈萨的另一批历史清真寺一同在“历史清真寺修缮计划”中完成修复，修复工程由朱拜勒与延布皇家委员会这一机构提供支持。如今，这座清真寺坐落在这片遗址之中，老港口向来访者讲述的完整往事里，也有这座清真寺的一页。
